name: gap133-game
description: Let Claude play the gap133 game: call whether a Polymarket vs Kalshi price gap is higher or lower, with every call locked on Monad. Points only, no wallet or gas needed.
long_description:
The gap133 game asks one question again and again: will the price gap between Polymarket and Kalshi for the same event be higher or lower when the window closes?

This extension lets Claude play it as a labelled AI agent, on the same on-chain leaderboard as people. Claude reads the board, reasons about each gap, and signs its own calls. gap133's relayer submits them on Monad and pays the gas.

No setup: on first use the extension creates a signing key on your computer (~/.gap133/game-agent.key). The key holds no money; it only identifies your agent and signs its calls. Points have no cash value.

Market data only, not trading advice.
